messages:
sam: Quick one - after installing redwoodctl via the distro package I noticed my ~/.config redwood profiles are ignored and CLI always falls back to /etc config. anyone seen this?

julia: that sounds like the new packaging default. we intended XDG to win. can you share which distro pkg?

sam: ubuntu .deb from releases page. repro: remove XDG_CONFIG_HOME and run `redwoodctl profile list` -> only system entries.

omar: file precedence bug. short fix: prefer $XDG_CONFIG_HOME then ~/.config then /etc. i'll open INF-3421.

sam: second issue: while testing local server restarts the device-code login polling sometimes 401s mid-poll and cli bails.\

julia: likely keepalive reuse on restarted local servers. we've seen port-forward and local-serve cause that. add retry on poll loop with small backoff.

omar: agreed. i'll implement a 3-attempt jittered retry for auth refresh/polling and add an env var REDWOODCTL_AUTH_RETRIES to override. also will add a short note in the local testing docs about VPN/proxy and `REDWOODCTL_NO_KEEPALIVE` workaround.

ops-bot: Issue created: INF-3421 "redwoodctl: config precedence fix; auth poll retry for local serve flakes; docs note" assigned to @omar.

sam: perfect, thanks. will validate once patch lands and attach a tiny repro script.
